name: Files changed renders the reviewer-ordered diff on seeded data
description: Walks L03b on the seeded PR #482: from the PR list into the detail route, onto the Files changed tab, and over every region of the grouped diff. Like flow 11 this makes NO model call — and here that is the feature rather than a constraint on the test. Smart Diff is deterministic by construction: `GET /pulls/:id/smart-diff` classifies paths with regexes, reads `finding_lines` off the reviews already in the database, and quotes its per-file summary out of the stored patch. `server/test/smart-diff.it.test.ts` proves the recorded-calls half (every provider mock stays empty and the `jobs` table does not grow); what this flow adds is that the whole thing really reaches a browser. Four assertions carry more than their length. 'Core logic' appearing BEFORE 'Boilerplate' is the acceptance criterion — the server returns the groups in that order and the client re-imposes it from its own `GROUP_ORDER`, so a regression in either shows here. The quoted summary 'bucketKey, rateLimit' is the no-LLM claim made visible: those two identifiers were copied out of the `@@` header tails of `src/middleware/ratelimit.ts`'s patch by a pure function, and a model that invented them would say something more fluent. '1 finding' plus 'blocker' is the overlay working end to end across the join that is easiest to get quietly wrong — the seeded review carries `agent_id: null`, so a per-agent reduction keyed on the raw value would collapse it and this badge would simply not exist (see `latestFindingsPerAgent`). And `order=original` in the URL proves the toggle is real state a link can carry, not local component state. Deliberately NOT asserted: that clicking a findings badge scrolls to the line. It cannot be expressed here, and the reason is worth writing down — the expansion rule opens any file that has findings, so on seeded data both flagged files (`src/config.ts`, `src/api/users.ts`) are ALREADY open and a click reveals nothing new. The collapsed-then-jumped path needs a file with findings that the reader has first collapsed by hand, which is a two-step interaction over an assertion about scroll position; it lives in `SmartDiffViewer.test.tsx` ('opens the collapsed file AND scrolls to the finding's line'), where `scrollIntoView` is stubbed to record the element id it landed on. Also not asserted: that `package-lock.json` starts COLLAPSED. The row is asserted present, but 'its patch text is absent' is a negative and this harness has only positive locators — that pin is `SmartDiffViewer.test.tsx`'s 'keeps the lock file collapsed'. Nor is the split-suggestion banner: the seeded PR is 47 changed lines against a 400-line threshold, so it correctly does not fire, and `server/test/smart-diff-split.test.ts` covers the case where it does. Precondition: a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api PR #482 is the first repo — run via `npm run e2e:hermetic`. NOTE the seed changed in L03b: `SEED_PR_PATCHES` carries real unified-diff text for nine files and the PR row's totals are DERIVED from it, so the summary line reads '9 files · +47'. A database seeded before that has four patch-less rows and this flow will fail on the summary and on every code line. LOCATOR CASING: 'REVIEWER-ORDERED DIFF' is asserted in the RENDERED casing — `SectionLabel` applies `text-transform: uppercase`, so the catalogue's sentence-case 'Reviewer-ordered diff' would time out against a screen that is on and correct. The group labels are NOT uppercased (they are a plain 650-weight span), so those are asserted as written.
